crossRefs.note: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam’s rock.
Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

translations.web: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.
translations.bsb: He breaks me with wound upon wound; He rushes me like a mighty warrior.
translations.kjv: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
translations.asv: He breaketh me with breach upon breach; He runneth upon me like a giant.
